entries.en: Pick up square stamp A and stamp once, fully inside the blue box, with its arrow aligned to the target arrow. Do not drag or stamp twice. Return the stamp to its holder in its original orientation and release it.
entries.zh: 拿起方头印章 A，在蓝框内完整盖一次，印上的箭头对齐目标箭头。不要拖动，也不要盖第二次。按原来的朝向把印章放回印章座并松开。

goal_recipe.easy:
Goal: Pick up square stamp A and stamp once, fully inside the blue box, with its arrow aligned to the target arrow. Do not drag or stamp twice. Return the stamp to its holder in its original orientation.

TASK RECIPE:
A 100 mm target box; heading error at most 5 degrees.

Use stamp A to make exactly one complete impression fully inside the blue box. Maintain stamp-face normal force of at least 5 N and tilt no greater than 10 degrees for at least 0.1 simulated seconds. During contact, do not translate more than 3 mm or twist more than 5 degrees. Align the stamp arrow with the target arrow; opposite or quarter-turn directions are not equivalent. Do not drag or stamp twice. Return the stamp to its holder in its initial orientation. At episode end, the stamp must have horizontal error less than 4 mm, vertical error less than 2 mm, yaw error less than 3 degrees and tilt less than 3 degrees relative to its original holder pose. Holding or releasing the stamp is allowed.

Scoring (highest eligible stage; stages are not added):
0: No complete physically valid impression, an impression outside the box, dragging or more than one stamp. Physical impression validity means the required force, tilt and contact duration; heading is evaluated separately.
15: Exactly one complete clean impression is inside the box, but its heading is outside this difficulty's tolerance.
30: That impression is also within heading tolerance, but the terminal holder pose is outside the return tolerances.
100: The complete clean single impression is inside the box within heading tolerance, and the terminal holder pose meets all return tolerances.
